### 🔵 Needs a closer look It reworks a security-sensitive directory-access boundary (shared between Create and Browse), which warrants human verification despite the behavior-preserving refactor and thorough tests.
2 open issues - [Prefilled cwd probe callback gets overwritten by autocomplete](https://github.com/blamechris/chroxy/pull/8639#discussion_r4305749854) · New - [Missing word makes cwd warning sentence hard to parse](https://github.com/blamechris/chroxy/pull/8639#discussion_r4305749867) · New
What changed in this PR This PR resolves issue 8303, where three code paths disagreed about which directories a session could use: Create (with an explicit cwd) ran `validateCwdAllowed`, Browse (`list_directory`) was `$HOME`-only, and a blank cwd silently inherited the configured default cwd unchecked. Browse now honours the same allow-set Create honours, and the New Session dialog proactively explains when a prefilled directory is not browsable. It fits into Chroxy's directory-access security model (the credential/config deny-list plus the opt-in `workspaceRoots` allowlist). **Changes:** - Extracted the shared pieces of `validateCwdAllowed` into reusable helpers (`resolveCwdPolicyHome`, `credentialDirDenialReason`, `resolveWorkspaceRoots`, `browseBoundaries`) so Create and Browse apply one policy, and rewired `listDirectory` to use the `$HOME` + workspace-roots + valid-default-cwd allow-set with the same credential/config deny-list. - Added a one-time startup warning (`warnIfConfiguredCwdRefused`) when the configured default cwd would be refused by `validateCwdAllowed`. - Dashboard `CreateSessionModal` now probes the prefilled cwd on open and shows a note when Browse can't open it; extensive new server and dashboard tests. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​server/​src/​handler-utils.js` | Extracted shared cwd-policy helpers and refactored `validateCwdAllowed` to call them (behavior-preserving). | | `packages/​server/​src/​ws-file-ops/​browser.js` | `listDirectory` now checks the credential deny-list and the `browseBoundaries` allow-set; late-bound `getConfig`/`getDefaultCwd`; new denial message. | | `packages/​server/​src/​ws-file-ops/​index.js` | Threads `browseOptions` into `createBrowserOps`. | | `packages/​server/​src/​ws-server.js` | Supplies late-bound `getConfig`/`getDefaultCwd` getters to `createFileOps`. | | `packages/​server/​src/​server-cli.js` | Adds `warnIfConfiguredCwdRefused`, called once at startup. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​components/​CreateSessionModal.tsx` | Probes the prefilled cwd and renders the "outside the browsable roots" note. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​browse-workspace-roots.test.js` | New unit tests for the Browse allow-set and deny-list. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​ws-server-file-ops.test.js` | New wiring tests through `WsServer`. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​server-cli-cwd-startup-warning.test.js` | New tests for the startup warning + wiring. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​components/​CreateSessionModalBrowsableNote.test.tsx` | New dashboard tests for the probe/note behavior. |
Review effort: Balanced
